title: Frequent warning pop-ups and drive-related alerts
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe frequent or possibly erroneous warning pop-ups, plus a few unrelated mentions of a restraint malfunction alert and a recurring noise after the car sits.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention overly frequent inattentive-driving warnings, repeated drive malfunction alerts, a driver restraint malfunction message, and a recurring noise after the vehicle has been parked for hours.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined review asks for fewer warnings and less information popping up, but it does not clearly establish the severity or specific defect involved.

limitations: The sample is very small, so examples are insufficient to characterize the full range of experiences beyond the fragments shown.
This cluster mixes warning pop-ups, a restraint malfunction alert, and a driving noise, so it may combine related but not fully coherent issues.
One fragment is truncated, limiting confidence about the exact nature of the restraint malfunction complaint.
